items.name: icons
items.title: Icons
items.description: YoRHa icon set: ChevronIcon, CheckIcon, CrossIcon, PlusIcon, MinusIcon, TriangleIcon, SortIcon, GripIcon, CalendarIcon, ClockIcon, EyeIcon, EyeOffIcon, SearchIcon. Thin wrappers over Glyph: integer-rect bitmaps (crispEdges, currentColor), sizes 12/16/20, no strokes.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project. Inspired by the YoRHa UI aesthetic; no original fonts, logos or assets are included. Icons render through @ui/glyph and are decorative (aria-hidden); put them in a `grid place-items-center` box and label the control, not the icon. v4 migration: no strokes any more, so `strokeWidth`/`stroke`/`solid` have no effect; the svg is `display:block`.
